<user_query>
Explore /root/lumiva-crm for integration-related code: integrations module, webhooks, OAuth, marketing sync, how leads/sales are created from external sources. List existing integration types/providers, key files, and gaps. Return concrete file paths and brief notes (no code changes).
</user_query>

Searching the lumiva-crm codebase for integrations, webhooks, OAuth, marketing sync, and external lead/sales creation.

[REDACTED]

Here is a concise map of integration-related code under `/root/lumiva-crm`, with **absolute paths** and **gaps**.

---

## Backend: integrations module (sales-side `IntegrationConnection`)

| Path | Note |
|------|------|
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integrations.module.ts` | Nest module: TypeORM entities, adapters (WooCommerce, third-party), exports `IntegrationsService`. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integrations.controller.ts` | JWT: `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /v1/integrations`, adapters list, `GET oauth-readiness`, `POST :id/test`, `POST :id/sync`. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integrations.service.ts` | Tenant CRUD, computed inbound URLs (`whatsapp`, `http_lead`, `amocrm`), sync orchestration, Slack/Teams/Zapier/Bitrix helpers for automations. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integration-registry.service.ts` | **Only** registers `WooCommerceAdapter` + `ThirdPartyLinkAdapter` (no dedicated adapter for `manual-import` / `other`). |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integration-kind.enum.ts` | Kinds: `woocommerce`, `manual-import`, `other`, `third_party_link`. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integration-connection.entity.ts` | DB model `integration_connections` (+ optional `channelId` for sales channel aggregates). |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integration-catalog.constants.ts` | Third-party **catalog IDs** + `INTEGRATION_OAUTH_<SUFFIX>_CLIENT_*` env suffix map. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/sales-integration.adapter.ts` | Contract: `testConnection`, `syncSales` → `SyncResult`. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/woocommerce/woocommerce.adapter.ts` | Pulls Woo orders → creates/updates **`Sale`** rows (`saleRepo.save`). |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/third-party-link/third-party-link.adapter.ts` | Per-`catalogId` **test** logic (Slack, Teams, Zapier, WA, calendars, Bitrix, amo API, HubSpot, Google Ads, Meta); `syncSales` is a **no-op** (message only). |

**Third-party services (same folder):**  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/slack/slack-webhook.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/teams/teams-webhook.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/zapier/zapier-hook.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/whatsapp/whatsapp-cloud.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/google-calendar/google-calendar.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/outlook/outlook-calendar.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/bitrix/bitrix-rest.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/amocrm/amocrm-api.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/hubspot/hubspot-api.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/google-ads/google-ads-api.service.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/meta-ads/meta-ads-graph.service.ts`.

**App wiring (webhook modules are separate from `IntegrationsModule`):**  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/app.module.ts` imports `WhatsappWebhookModule`, `InboundLeadWebhookModule`, `AmocrmInboundWebhookModule`.

---

## Public inbound webhooks (no JWT on these controllers)

| Path | Route | Creates / updates |
|------|--------|-------------------|
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/inbound-lead/inbound-lead-webhook.controller.ts` | `POST /v1/webhooks/inbound-leads/:connectionId` | Delegates to service. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/inbound-lead/inbound-lead-webhook.service.ts` | — | **`http_lead`**: verifies secret → **`LeadsService.createForTenant`** or match by phone/email → **note** with JSON. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/whatsapp/whatsapp-webhook.controller.ts` | `GET/POST /v1/webhooks/whatsapp/:connectionId` | Meta verify + inbound. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/whatsapp/whatsapp-webhook.service.ts` | — | **`whatsapp`**: **`createForTenant`** for new WA senders (phone-based) + notes. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/amocrm/amocrm-inbound-webhook.controller.ts` | `POST /v1/webhooks/amocrm/:connectionId` | amo inbound. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/amocrm/amocrm-inbound-webhook.service.ts` | — | Parses amo payloads → **lead create/update** + mapping notes (large file). |

Companion modules:  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/inbound-lead/inbound-lead-webhook.module.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/whatsapp/whatsapp-webhook.module.ts`,  
`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/amocrm/amocrm-inbound-webhook.module.ts`.

---

## OAuth (distinct areas)

| Path | Note |
|------|------|
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/email/email-oauth-actions.controller.ts` | `@Controller('email/oauth')` — starts Gmail/Microsoft OAuth (JWT side). |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/email/email-oauth-public.controller.ts` | Same path prefix: **callbacks** with signed `state` (no JWT). |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/email/email-oauth.service.ts` | (referenced by controllers; token refresh, URLs.) |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/email/email-oauth-state.util.ts` | HMAC state encoding. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integrations.controller.ts` | `GET /v1/integrations/oauth-readiness`. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/platform-settings/platform-settings.service.ts` | `getIntegrationOauthReadinessMap()` — DB `integrationOAuthApps` or `INTEGRATION_OAUTH_<SUFFIX>_CLIENT_ID/SECRET` per **third-party catalog** id. |

OAuth for **Google Ads / Meta / calendars** in sales connections is mostly **token fields in JSON** (see third-party adapter hints), not the same flow as mailbox OAuth.

---

## Marketing: integrations + sync + external traffic import

| Path | Note |
|------|------|
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/marketing/marketing-integration.entity.ts` | Table `marketing_integrations`: `provider`, `kind`, `settings` JSON; comment mentions GA4, Meta, Yandex, Google Ads, TikTok-style names — **implementation** is in service. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/marketing/dto/create-marketing-integration.dto.ts` | DTO: free-form `provider`, optional `settings`, GA4 SA JSON field. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/marketing/dto/update-marketing-integration.dto.ts` | Partial update. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/marketing/marketing.controller.ts` | JWT: `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /v1/marketing/integrations`, `POST /v1/marketing/integrations/:id/sync`. **`POST /v1/marketing/traffic/import`** uses **`ApiTokenGuard`** (API key → tenant), not JWT. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/marketing/marketing.service.ts` | `syncMarketingIntegrationById`: **Google Ads**, **Yandex Metrika** variants, **GA4** variants, **Meta Ads** (`isMetaAdsProvider`); writes **`marketing_traffic`**. Also `importTraffic` for scripted/n8n pushes. |

---

## Sales from external sources (summary)

| Source | Mechanism | Where |
|--------|-----------|--------|
| WooCommerce | Scheduled/manual **sync** → **`Sale`** | `woocommerce.adapter.ts` |
| HTTP lead forms / Zapier / Make | **POST** inbound webhook | `inbound-lead-webhook.*` |
| WhatsApp (Meta Cloud) | Inbound webhook | `whatsapp-webhook.*` |
| amoCRM | Inbound webhook | `amocrm-inbound-webhook.*` |
| Telegram | Inbound messages → lead | `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/telegram-crm/telegram-crm.service.ts` (e.g. `createForTenant` around lead flow) |
| AI / internal | Tooling | `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/ai/ai-tools.service.ts` (`toolCreateLead` → `LeadsService.createForTenant`) |
| Bitrix / HubSpot | **Outbound** automation steps (`send_bitrix`, `send_hubspot`) | `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/automations/automations.service.ts` |
| Outbound “call webhook” | Automation action | `trigger_webhook` / webhook sends in same file |

**Billing:** Stripe webhook (not CRM entity import): `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/billing/billing.service.ts` (`constructEvent`).

---

## Frontend (integration UX)

| Path | Note |
|------|------|
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/api/integrations.ts` | Client types + DTOs aligned with backend. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/sales/SalesIntegrationsPage.tsx`, `SalesIntegrationNewPage.tsx` | Sales integrations UI. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/marketing/MarketingIntegrationsPage.tsx` | Marketing integrations UI. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/automations/integrationsCatalog.ts` | Product catalog: live vs roadmap, links. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/public/IntegrationsPage.tsx` | Public marketing page. |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/automations/IntegrationBrandIcon.tsx` | Icons. |

---

## Other “integration” entity

| Path | Note |
|------|------|
| `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/smm/smm-integration.entity.ts` | SMM tokens (`meta` \| `vk`) — separate from sales `IntegrationConnection` and marketing integrations. |

---

## Catalog: types / providers

**Sales `IntegrationKind`:** `woocommerce`, `manual-import`, `other`, `third_party_link` — `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integration-kind.enum.ts`.

**Third-party `catalogId` values (config JSON):**  
`slack`, `ms_teams`, `google_calendar`, `outlook`, `whatsapp`, `http_lead`, `bitrix`, `amocrm`, `hubspot`, `zapier`, `google_ads`, `meta_ads`, `1c`, `sap`, `jira`, `openai` — `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/integrations/integration-catalog.constants.ts`.

**Marketing `MarketingIntegration.provider`:** validated/normalized in service (sync supports **google_ads**, **yandex_***, **ga4 / google_analytics***, **meta** family); DTO allows any string up to 80 chars — `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/marketing/marketing.service.ts` (`syncMarketingIntegrationById`).

---

## Gaps / inconsistencies (brief)

1. **`manual-import` and `other`**: listed as kinds but **no adapter** in `integration-registry.service.ts` → `syncForTenant` hits “adapter not found” for those kinds unless treated elsewhere (they are not registered).  
2. **`third_party_link` `syncSales`**: always no-op — by design for “credentials only” connections; no sales import from Bitrix/HubSpot via this path.  
3. **Catalog vs implementation**: IDs like `1c`, `sap`, `jira`, `openai` appear in OAuth readiness env map; **inbound lead creation** is only clearly wired for `http_lead`, `whatsapp`, `amoCRM` webhooks (plus Telegram module).  
4. **Marketing entity comment vs code**: `marketing-integration.entity.ts` mentions TikTok-style providers; **no `tiktok` match** in `marketing.service.ts` grep — likely roadmap / unused.  
5. **Two marketing ingestion paths**: (a) **`MarketingIntegration` + `POST …/integrations/:id/sync`** (JWT) pulls from ad/analytics APIs into `marketing_traffic`; (b) **`POST /v1/marketing/traffic/import`** (`ApiTokenGuard`) pushes rows — different auth and use case.  
6. **`INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`**: `/root/lumiva-crm/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md` is about **internal** Company/Contact/Lead linking — not external system integrations (easy to confuse by filename).  
7. **Inbound HTTP lead controller**: always returns `{ ok: true }` even on errors (errors logged) — callers cannot distinguish failure without logs (`inbound-lead-webhook.controller.ts`).  
8. **Bitrix/HubSpot**: strong support as **outgoing** automation/API usage; **inbound** lead sync is not the same class as amo/http/WA webhooks.

---

If you want a follow-up, the same structure can be traced for **automation trigger types** only (`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/automations/automation.entity.ts` + `automations.service.ts`) or for **API token** mechanics (`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/api-tokens/`).
